sec.title: August 28 Archival Metadata Enrichment (Increment 261)
sec.p: This archival dispatch documents the historical provenance, broadcast scheduling, commercial sponsorship, credited cast, production personnel, alternate circulating titles, and pure narrative synopses for broadcasts transmitting on **August 28** across American network radio and Armed Forces Radio Service, Himan Brown's chilling poker murder thriller on *Inner Sanctum Mystery* for Carter's Little Liver Pills, two humanitarian town dramas starring Jean Hersholt in *Dr. Christian* for Vaseline, and three premier Armed Forces Radio Service *One Night Stand* big band sessions (Jimmy Dorsey, Desi Arnaz at Ciro's, and Gene Krupa with Anita O'Day) (1940–1946):
